## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector returns (6/11 positive) and major divergences among large caps (NVDA CORRECTION, PANW CORRECTION, META RECOVERY) with concentrated top-performer grouping. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Materials & Healthcare).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +16.52% | 1M: +44.58%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W momentum: EL (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +16.52% | 1M: +44.58%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +21.34%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergences to note: NVDA (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +8.42%) CORRECTION, PANW (1W: -9.15% | 1M: +7.12%) CORRECTION, JPM (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +0.14%) CORRECTION — tactical watch.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Technology mixed with distribution signs at the top end: MSFT (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +26.61%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.25%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +8.42%) CORRECTION, AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND — sector tone: rotational and narrow leadership.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials are mixed: V (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +6.16%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +8.64%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +0.14%) CORRECTION — Style: mixed / no clear leadership given uneven bank vs. card network performance.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare displaying depth: MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND; watch UNH (1W: +0.68% | 1M: -5.04%) RECOVERY for confirmation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Materials and Healthcare exposure (FCX, NEM, MRK) and reduce exposure to Technology and Industrials names showing BELOW TREND (AVGO, AMAT, LMT). Monitor NVDA (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +8.42%) CORRECTION, PANW (1W: -9.15% | 1M: +7.12%) CORRECTION and JPM (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +0.14%) CORRECTION for trend confirmation before making core shifts.

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +16.52% | 1M: +44.58%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -9.53% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -9.15% | 1M: +7.12%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +3.31%, 11 stocks), Healthcare (1W: +2.94%, 17 stocks), Consumer Staples (1W: +3.38%, 14 stocks) on concentrated movers. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.27%, 24 stocks), Industrials (1W: -1.64%, 15 stocks), Energy (1W: -2.04%, 10 stocks).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +8.42%) CORRECTION — needs a sustained weekly reversal to flip short-term tone; FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold weekly gains would signal quick mean reversion; MSFT (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +26.61%) ABOVE TREND — continued weekly strength keeps broad Tech participation intact.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
JNJ (+80): J&J Imaavy expanded approval — JNJ (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. BA (+65): F‑15 contract headline — BA (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -0.20%) BELOW TREND, news is constructive but price is not confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
META (-50): lawsuit settlement chatter — META (1W: +4.85% | 1M: -4.01%) RECOVERY, negative headlines diverge from recent 1W strength (distribution risk). AVGO (-50): analyst caution — AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND, news confirms price weakness; GOOGL (-45): cost structure headlines — GOOGL (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.25%) ABOVE TREND, news is a divergence to monitor; WMT (-45): earnings miss headlines — WMT (1W: -8.31% | 1M: -5.47%) BELOW TREND, sentiment and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed with a narrow leadership tilt toward Materials and Healthcare. FCX ABOVE TREND, MRK ABOVE TREND and EL ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risks: NVDA CORRECTION, PANW CORRECTION and headline-price divergences (META vs. news) that could unsettle breadth.
